title: Quantitative Superexponential Bounds for van der Waerden Numbers
summary: We prove that there are absolute constants c > 0 and K 0 such that $`W_r(k)\gt k^{ck\lfloor\log_2 r\rfloor}`$ for every $`k\ge K_0`$ and r ≥ 2. Consequently $`W_r(k)^{1/k}\to\infty`$ for each fixed r ≥ 2, giving a quantitative positive resolution of Erdős's superexponential-growth question, including the two-color case.

review.reason: Proves superexponential lower bounds for van der Waerden numbers, addressing an Erdős question.
